title: Redemption

authorInfo.bio: Edward Hoare (1812–1894) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Redemption" by Edward Hoare is a religious text written in the late 19th century. This work explores the concept of redemption in the context of Christian faith, emphasizing both the importance of emotional religion and a solid foundation in divine truth.
